back_translation: I saw the Lord standing beside the altar, and He said: 'Strike the tops of the pillars so that the thresholds shake, and shatter them on the heads of all the people. The last of them I will kill with the sword; not one of them will flee, not one will escape.
Though they dig down to Sheol, from there My hand will seize them; and though they climb up to heaven, from there I will bring them down.
Though they hide on the top of Carmel, I will search them out and seize them from there; and though they hide from My sight at the bottom of the sea, there I will command the serpent to bite them.
Though they go into captivity before their enemies, there I will command the sword to slay them. I will fix My eyes on them for harm and not for good.
The Lord GOD of Hosts is the One who touches the earth and it melts, and all who dwell in it mourn; the whole land rises like the Nile and sinks again like the Nile of Egypt.
He builds His upper chambers in the heavens and establishes His vault over the earth; He calls for the waters of the sea and pours them out on the face of the earth—the LORD is His name.
The LORD says: O Israelites, are you not like the Cushites to Me? Did I not bring Israel up from the land of Egypt, and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Arameans from Kir?
Behold, the Lord GOD watches the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from the face of the earth—yet I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob, declares the LORD.
For behold, I will give the command, and I will shake the house of Israel among all the nations as grain is shaken in a sieve, but not a single kernel will fall to the ground.
All the sinners among My people will die by the sword—those who say, 'Disaster will not overtake or confront us.'
In that day I will raise up the fallen booth of David; I will repair its breaches, raise up its ruins, and rebuild it as in the days of old,
so that they may possess the remnant of Edom and all the nations that are called by My name, declares the LORD who does this.

The LORD says: Behold, the days are coming when the plowman will overtake the reaper and the treader of grapes the one who sows the seed; the mountains will drip new wine, and all the hills will flow with it.
I will restore My people Israel to well-being; they will rebuild the ruined cities and live in them, plant vineyards and drink their wine, make gardens and eat their fruit.
I will plant them on their own land, and they will never again be uprooted from the land I have given them, says the LORD your God.
